_comment: The movement patterns the Form Coach can judge, and the rules that map a
catalog row onto one. Projected into the catalog as `poseTargetId`.
A pattern is NOT an exercise. A back squat, a front squat, a goblet squat
and an air squat are one silhouette seen from the side, so they share one
hand-authored target. That is why the authoring cost is paid per pattern
and the coverage is counted per exercise.
`excludeWhen` is the same list for every pattern on purpose: what makes a
movement unjudgeable by one side-on camera is the same in each case --
a machine or bench that hides the hip line, or a seated/lying position in
which the shoulder-hip-knee chain means nothing. BlazePose has no spinal
landmark at any configuration, which is what already forced two rules to
be silenced (see form_classifier.dart); nothing here can recover it.

patterns.label: Squat
_notTitleWhy: `squatTopTarget`/`squatBottomTarget` encode ONE thing: a bilateral,
upright squat seen from the side. Everything below carries the word
'squat' and is not that, so the target would score a correct rep
badly -- and this is the only pattern the coach currently supports,
so every false positive here reaches a user immediately.
split stance      split squat, bulgarian -- the lunge silhouette.
Without this they matched two patterns and the
ambiguity rule dropped all 40, which was correct
behaviour applied to a question that was never
ambiguous. Handled per pattern rather than by a
global precedence order, because 'Alternating
Plank Lunge' really IS ambiguous and a precedence
rule would have silently resolved that one too.
not sagittal      side, lateral, curtsy, cossack, skater -- these
happen across the frontal plane, which a side-on
camera sees edge-on.
not bilateral     pistol, single leg, sissy -- a different shape,
and the target's two legs are drawn together.
not upright       kneeling, jefferson.
isometric         squat hold, wall squat: RepCounter needs a full
lap of the phase ladder, and a hold never leaves
the bottom. No reps, nothing to score.
two movements     squat + press/row/raise/reach/punch/kick/burpee.
One silhouette cannot judge two movements.
false friend      'Barbell Incline Shoulders Press (inside Squat
Cage)' is not a squat at all -- the word is in
the equipment's name. Caught by 'squat cage'.
Deliberately NOT excluded: 'Squat to Grass' (a depth cue, not a
second movement), 'with 2 Sec Hold' and 'with Rack' (a paused squat
still completes a lap), and sumo. Sumo from the side is imperfect --
the knees splay away from the camera -- but it is a judgement call
worth making with a measurement rather than a guess.
